question: Which scriptural authorities affirm the teaching about the liberated knower?
premises: The Supreme Lord stated this in the Ratnamala scripture.
The Lord Ahi, bearer of the burden of supporting the universe, stated it in his own scripture.
inference: The doctrine of the knower's liberation is supported by multiple revered scriptural sources.
uncertainties: ahīśāna may refer to a specific tantric deity or epithet; rendered as Lord Ahi.
plain_english: The Supreme Lord said this in the holy Ratnamala scripture, and so did the Lord Ahi, bearer of the burden of supporting the universe, in his own scripture.
